commands.documentation: Yarn: <![CDATA[<<increase_affection Sarah 5>>]]>. Adds affection; the InteractableNPC setter clamps to +20 automatically. Fires the global increase event AND this NPC's specific increase event.

Yarn: <![CDATA[<<decrease_affection Sarah 5>>]]>. Subtracts affection; the InteractableNPC setter clamps to -20 automatically. Always treats the amount as its absolute value so a negative in Yarn can't accidentally re-invert the operation.
